answer: In PoA, each edge contribution is time-decayed with an exponential half-life, so reputation must be earned through sustained honest service rather than a brief burst. EigenTrust normalization then gives freshly spawned sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality: with no trusted incoming mass, they cannot influence the stationary distribution or pass consensus. Even umber, lagoon, and onyx clusters remain isolated until independently vouched for.
